events.title: Launch date, launch trailer and 1k+ wishlists
events.summary: Hey Greenhorns!The game will be released on Friday, November 6th.A new launch trailer and fresh screenshots are now available featuring the final map.The game has also reached 1,000+ wishlists here on Steam—all achieved organically—for which I am truly grateful!Thanks, and see you in the cave!

events.title: Demo Update
events.summary: A brief update for the demo:- Color adjustmentsSome people had trouble distinguishing the coins in the darker parts of the map, so I made the coins a bit more vibrant- Controller supportIt is now possible to play the entire demo using a controller- Coin bonus for completing all items in the same category- Bugged fonts have been fixed- Resolved the issue where money would disappear from the UI- Fixed other minor UI and lighting bugs

events.title: DEMO OUT NOW
events.summary: Hello everyone!The demo is now live and ready to play. It lasts about 30–35 minutes and the content within it will NOT be available in the final game. The demo serves to organize the "fake" treasure, while the final game will feature only the "real" one.The demo also features its own achievements. So if you're like me and enjoy unlocking it, this is a great demo for that.Thanks in advance to everyone who plays.

events.title: Demo coming soon
events.summary: Hello everyone reading this!I’m the game's solo developer, and I’d like to announce the demo: it’s arriving in mid-September (like 10~15 days from now) and will offer a preview of what the game is all about. The demo will feature achievements and provide around 30 to 35 minutes of gameplay.I know organization games are trending and that few developers release demos for it, but I truly believe having a demo is essential for any indie game.That’s it—thanks for reading this far.
